name: Expense Provision
description: Month-end provision (accrual) for a recurring/estimated expense - electricity, bank interest, freight, audit/professional fees, etc. On submit it books the provision Journal Entry (Expense Dr / Provision Cr) and stays Open until actual documents (Purchase Invoice / Journal Entry) are matched against it via their 'Provision Against' link. Supports partial settlement and over/under variance.

fields.label: Posting Date
fields.description: Month-end date the provision is booked on (e.g. 31-Mar).

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Draft
Open
Partially Settled
Settled
Reversed
Cancelled

fields.label: Reversal Mode
fields.description: Match and Settle: keep the provision Open and consume it as actual invoices/JEs are linked (explicit provision-to-actual matching). Auto-Reverse: the monthly scheduler reverses any unsettled balance at the start of the next month (classic accrual reversal).

fields.label: Expense Account
fields.description: P&L expense being accrued (Electricity, Interest, Freight, ...).

fields.label: Provision Account
fields.description: Liability account holding the accrual (Provision for Expenses / Accrued Expenses).

fields.label: Cost Center
fields.description: Cost center for the expense leg (mandatory on P&L accounts in ERPNext).

fields.label: Party Type
fields.description: Optional - e.g. Supplier for a known vendor, or the bank for interest.

fields.label: Utilized
fields.description: Sum of amounts consumed by linked actual documents.

fields.label: Settlements
fields.description: One row per actual document matched against this provision (added automatically when a Purchase Invoice / Journal Entry linking this provision is submitted).

fields.label: Provision Journal Entry
fields.description: The Expense Dr / Provision Cr entry auto-created on submit.
